content:
As the iPhone Duo release date approaches, Apple is now accepting submissions for apps and games built with Xcode 27.1 and optimized for iPhone Duo. Here are the relevant details.

App Store Connect will require iPhone Duo screenshots for submissions starting April 2027

Over the past few weeks, Apple has released Xcode 27.1 beta versions supporting the development and testing of iPhone Duo apps and games. The company today released Xcode 27.1 Release Candidate 1, which developers can download here.

Earlier tonight, Apple published an article through its Developer News Hub announcing that developers can now submit iPhone Duo-optimized apps and games on App Store Connect:

When you build or recompile with Xcode 27.1, your App Store product page will display a badge letting users know your app is optimized for iPhone Duo.

Apple specifically emphasized that starting April 2027, any app or game submitted to App Store Connect must include iPhone Duo screenshots.

In the same news article, Apple highlighted that recompiling existing apps with Xcode 27.1 is all it takes to add iPhone Duo development support, and that developers can use the Device Hub to visually preview how their apps will look on the new device across different postures and orientations.

Apple also listed a number of resources to help developers prepare for iPhone Duo and their App Store product pages, including:

  • Get design guidelines and templates
  • Manage your App Store assets
  • View app preview specifications
  • View screenshot specifications

Apple will also be hosting several in-person iPhone Duo workshops over the coming days; details and registration are available here.

iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with deliveries and in-store availability beginning October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can begin preparing for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12; you can read the details here.
